title: Crouch under trouble
situation: A low beam across the path. The walk drops into a crouched walk before the beam, the head looks back once without the feet breaking stride, and she stands only after her head has cleared it. The beam is solid: head, chest and hands are checked against it.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
